faq.question: Is WORKMODEDOM a VPS promo code?
faq.answer: The official monthly page assigns it to domain registrations and transfers. We did not verify a VPS code in the monthly coupon page or VPS plan cards reviewed.

faq.question: Does a newsletter subscription unlock a verified discount?
faq.answer: The promotions page advertises a monthly deals newsletter. It does not state a guaranteed sign-up discount there.

faq.question: How do I request a hosting refund?
faq.answer: Namecheap's help article instructs customers to cancel hosting and contact Billing/Sales through Live Chat or billing@namecheap.com. The legal policy's exclusions still need to be checked for your purchase.
